mode: Window-free egui and unit/lint checks only. No desktop, native-window or screenshot-preview launches.

focused_gui.scope: Stable reachable OK/Cancel, scrollable picker/numeric/custom controls, staged cancellation, custom palette acceptance/persistence without document/history mutation; existing RGB/HSL, invalid hex and secondary-color checks retained.

color_unit.scope: RGB/HSL byte-channel round trips, alpha preservation and chromatic intent at black

limits: No rendered/native visual qualification under the user restriction. Basic palette values and native color-processing parity remain unqualified; this pass changes presentation, not the conversion policy.
